label: Bank, finance or insurance
summary: Strict regulatory compliance on financial returns and risks
No guaranteed-return or risk-free investment claims
Clear, transparent disclosures regarding fees and capital conditions
tone_principles: Prudent, transparent, compliant, and objective. Never promise speculative gains or downplay capital risk.
writing_style: Formal, unambiguous sentences with transparent qualifiers and necessary regulatory disclosures.
messaging_principles: Every financial product statement must acknowledge capital risk, eligibility requirements, and relevant terms.
do_examples: Yield rates vary based on market conditions. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
Accounts are insured up to statutory deposit limits under applicable banking regulations.
dont_examples: Our fund offers 100% risk-free guaranteed returns of 25% annually!
You can't lose money—get rich quick before legacy banks steal your savings!

rules.title: Prohibit Guaranteed Returns & Risk-Free Investment Claims
rules.description: Financial communications must not state or imply guaranteed profits, risk-free growth, or capital invulnerability.

suggested_replacements.guaranteed returns: projected target returns based on historical scenarios
suggested_replacements.guaranteed profits: potential earnings subject to market factors
suggested_replacements.100% risk-free: structured with defined risk mitigation strategies

rules.do_example: Returns depend on prevailing interest rates and market movements.
rules.dont_example: Earn guaranteed returns of 12% with our 100% risk-free strategy.

rules.title: Prohibit Alarmist Urgency & Predatory Financial Rhetoric
rules.description: Do not incite panic regarding banking stability or pressure customers with scare tactics.

suggested_replacements.before your money disappears: to evaluate current inflation impacts on

rules.do_example: Diversify institutional treasury holdings to manage counterparty concentration.
rules.dont_example: Traditional banks are destroying your wealth—move your funds immediately!

terminology.preferred: capital remains subject to market risk
terminology.replacement: capital remains subject to market risk
terminology.notes: Financial compliance requires explicit capital risk disclosures.
Fee schedules must be clearly documented rather than absolute blanket promises.
